Cadre 3.7.1 fixes review and revision proposals that failed before an approval
digest could be returned. Canonical state and completed execution evidence remain
unchanged until the exact proposal is approved.

## Fixes

- Validate staged review/revision plans against their intended lifecycle status.
- Preserve completed historical verification phases and their original dependencies
  when remediation adds a new final gate.
- Carry completed nodes into replacement executions without rewriting old journals.
- Keep historical handoffs readable between approved promotion and replacement
  execution, clearly labeled with their recorded revision and graph.
- Reject conflicting staged statuses, empty approved plans, malformed staged plan
  syntax, and terminal-track reopening while retaining active execution checks.
- Allow missing or malformed unapproved drafts to be repaired through staging.

## Upgrade

```bash
npm install -g cadre-ai@3.7.1
cadre-ai doctor
cadre-ai install --target all --scope user
```

Start a new Codex task, run `/reload-plugins` in Claude Code, and open a new Zed
Agent thread. Existing projects remain readable and use an approved refresh to
record runtime 3.7.1 before delivery. Template set v3 and all published templates
are unchanged. Re-inspect blocked review candidates with the updated server and
approve the returned digest; installation itself does not approve remediation.

## Validation

82 automated tests, strict TypeScript checks, package validation and dry-run
inspection, documentation checks, and native Codex/Claude/Zed installation,
discovery, and MCP activation. Zed remains beta.

Read the [package changelog](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/blob/release-3.7.1/harness/CHANGELOG.md)
or the [full comparison](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/compare/release-3.7.0...release-3.7.1).
